admin_api_key.description: Admin API key. Only needed when managing organizations. Can also come from LANGFUSE_ADMIN_KEY.

host.description: Base URI of the Langfuse instance (defaults to https://app.langfuse.com).

secret_key.description: Secret key for the LLM API. Not returned by Langfuse after upsert.
